scope: External empirical comparison; no change to main WM assumptions
core_weights: Probability weights W(X) or W(Z,X); X may include observed response and selection features beyond matching coordinates
target: Finite source-population PATT, separately computed for all 18 populations
sample_seeds: replicate IDs 1:1000; reconstruction choice because historical replicate list is unavailable
local_pilot_purpose: Validate complete run/failure/output contract and measure runtime/storage; no precision claims about bias or coverage

native_methods.matching: Original probability PS, nearest neighbor, ratio 1, without replacement
native_methods.interval: Original survey outcome-regression SE and estimate +/- 1.96 SE; preserve source strict coverage indicator
native_methods.response_weights: Original fitted response probability from complete selected sample; sampling weight divided by that probability

adapted_matchit_methods.matching: Official vignette generalized full ATT with final probability weight included as a PS covariate
adapted_matchit_methods.outcome: Treatment-by-X interaction regression; matching times sampling/response weights used once; treated target contrast uses probability weights
adapted_matchit_methods.interval: Subclass HC1 sandwich with qnorm(.975); empirical comparator, not a new survey-design theorem

WM_methods.matching: Fixed M with replacement, Euclidean supplied coordinates, exact distance then row-index ties, self-normalized donor fractions
WM_methods.PS: Probability-weighted logistic PS on X1:X6, scalar affine standardization; weighted full-X linear control correction
WM_methods.DSM: Own-arm double score for PATT: weighted PS, ordinary control PG, source weighted quadratic double-score correction
WM_methods.X6: Pooled divisor-n standardized six covariates; weighted full-X linear control correction
WM_methods.interval: Original fixed-reuse count bootstrap with refitted prediction stack, divisor B and qnorm(.975); supplied fitted response weights frozen
WM_methods.inference_claim: Empirical external-design coverage evaluation only; does not claim to account for response-estimation or cluster/stratum design uncertainty

batching: Six multipliers share source covariates/Z/response/control outcomes; common graphs and WM control refits. Native and quick outcome regressions/SEs still evaluated separately. First-outcome failure never automatically fails later outcomes.
failure_policy: Retain each prescribed dataset, method, outcome and count. No reseeding, replacement counts, changing B, or successful-draw-only variance. Keep finite point estimates when intervals fail. Preserve nonfinite native results and warnings as diagnostic records; do not numerically regularize the source comparator.

formal_metrics.bias: mean(estimates)-population PATT; source absolute bias is its absolute value
formal_metrics.relative_efficiency: empirical variance of Lenis_U_PS_U_OM_OW_U divided by method empirical variance, within same population scenario/multiplier/response
formal_metrics.coverage: Report valid interval rate and operational coverage over all prescribed replicates; separately label any conditional-on-success diagnostic
formal_metrics.MCSE: Use paired replicate identities for method differences and variance-ratio delta MCSE; do not treat six multipliers as independent replications

publication_population_identity: Unresolved: supplied source populations differ from printed Table 1. No historical numerical-identity claim or seed hunting.
publication_boundary: Code only after independent validation; paper, private source files, caches and notes remain local
